BIG RESULT: Peggy Flanagan wins the Democratic nomination for the U.S. Senate seat in Minnesota, easily beating moderate Angie Craig. (AP calls it.)

This is Tina Smith's seat. A big primary that was defined in part by Craig's support for the Laken Riley Act.
